text: ぶるぶる…　かみさま　ほとけさま　たすけて
note: かみさま ほとけさま is a stock Japanese plea in a crisis, calling on both the Shinto gods and the Buddha at once. The English game dropped the religious wording.
claim: 神様仏様 (kamisama hotokesama) is a set Japanese phrase used when pleading for help, invoking both gods and Buddha.

check.quote: God and Buddha; Gods and Buddhas; one's guardian angel
